messages:
devon: FYI QA reported seeing rows from AcmeCorp in a different customer's quickinsight panel; repro after the morning routing policy rollout.

sasha: Wha — which panel? can you paste screenshot or query id?

devon: Quickinsight panel id q1234. Steps: switch org -> open panel -> see 3 rows with org_id=acme in table. Happened ~08:15 UTC. Attaching stacktrace from console: `GET /api/insights?qid=q1234&workspace=team-x` returned rows with wrong org header

qa-bot: Repro steps confirmed on env=staging, user=qa_sam. Snapshot: https://staging.redwood.internal/insights/q1234/snapshot

rohan: Could be sampler service. We changed routing keys to use `session_id` only in last deploy. If sampler key omitted org_id, its cache can return other tenants' samples.

maya: I noticed sampler's cache key is `sampler:{region}:{session_id}:{model}` in k/v. Should be `sampler:{region}:{org_id}:{session_id}:{model}`

sasha: @rohan can you grep commit that changed key? I think it was 3cf9a2 in rr-adapter.

rohan: Yup, that commit removed org_id to reduce cardinality. It was a misguided perf tweak. Opening PR to revert + add unit tests. Draft: https://git.redwood/rr-adapter/pulls/789

devon: Immediate mitigation: roll back the sampler change on prod canary (10%) and purge sampler cache for affected shards. Any objections?

chin: Doable. I'll trigger cache purge script and start rollback canary. Purge command: `kubectl exec sampler-0 -- /app/bin/cache-purge --shard=shard-7`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollback started for rr-adapter -> version v1.3.2 -> initiated by chin. Tracking: DPL-2024-358

sasha: Also we need to check telemetry/quotas mapping. If sampler returned other tenant's rows, billing might have been misattributed. @finance FYI

devon: Agreed. Need a temporary instrumentation to count org_id mismatches: add histogram `insights.org_mismatch` with labels (expected_org, returned_org). I'll spike a small patch.

rohan: I'll add the key fix + test, push to staging, run QA repro then ship. ETA 2 hours.

qa-bot: Staging repro now fails (good) after applying patch. snapshot: https://staging.redwood.internal/insights/q1234/after-patch

chin: Rollback canary at 10% finished, purge done for shards 5-9. prod telemetry shows mismatch metric dropping to zero in last 5 min :sparkles:

devon: Thanks all. Followups: (1) postmortem draft, (2) add org_id to our sampler key policy doc, (3) add automated test in e2e for cross-org leak. I'll open tickets.

sasha: :thumbsup:
